repeatable.details: All six files in content/recipes use the shared loader in src/lib/content/recipes.ts, the strict schema and Markdown parser in src/lib/content/, and the /recipes/{slug} route generated by src/app/recipes/[slug]/page.tsx. npm run validate:content reported 6 published recipes and 0 drafts.

structure.details: npm run validate:content, npm test (18/18), npm run lint, and npm run build passed. The loader enforces frontmatter, exactly one Ingredients unordered list, one Method ordered list, optional Notes in that order, flat lowercase-hyphen slugs, existing local image files, and CommonMark without raw HTML. The production build generated all six recipe routes.

preservation.details: git diff --exit-code b9a87c91e33b07c2b0a33ba6a0527c9f5201b670 over content/recipes, public/images/recipes, the loaders, renderers, and recipe routes returned zero. No entry text, frontmatter, URL, ordering rule, loader, renderer, or media changed. Desktop rendering was visually reviewed at test-results/recipe-flow-recipe-navigat-2bb17--printing-and-metadata-work-desktop/recipe.png.

narrowScreen.details: Eight Playwright flows passed against the production build at 1440px and exactly 375px. Tests verified loaded images, navigation, ingredient interaction, metadata, print rendering, category routes, and document width not exceeding the viewport. Visual review of test-results/recipe-flow-recipe-navigat-2bb17--printing-and-metadata-work-narrow-375/recipe.png confirmed readable stacking and preserved Ingredients, Method, Notes, and related-recipe order without horizontal overflow.

reviewedChanges: No application code, recipe content, route, loader, renderer, workflow, dependency, or media changes. Adds only .publishraw/collections.json and this evidence report for owner review.
